title: The Bittersweet Art of Acceptance
overview: A Neo Nazi man comes face to face with An Arab man, whom had been a victim to his hateful ideology, resulting in the death of his brother. But came to him not in hatred but to find out why he was the way he was. And to befriend him and teach him love…
